summary:
Frontend-only testing of the new design.html (NOVA Konut static site, http://localhost:3000) plus light regression on index.html, about.html and construction.html section 06. Verified: responsive overflow at 11 viewports, image loading (16 design images), GSAP reveal completeness (slow scroll / fast scroll / scroll back up, desktop + mobile), design index nav smooth-scroll + active state, clipping/overlap scan, existing NOVA chrome (hamburger, side menu DESIGN link, close, footer DESIGN link) and the two page links. 2 real defects found: (1) mobile <=720px CSS hides
in headings without a replacement space, concatenating words in 7 headings; (2) the design index active state (is-on) is wrong for Interiors, Materials and Landscape because js marks the last matching link in LINK order instead of document order. Everything else passed.

ui_bugs.issue:
css/design.css:314-316 `.dz-h1 br, .dz-h2 br, .dz-statement br { display:none }` removes the line break without inserting a space, so words are glued together on every viewport <=720px (verified 390 & 360). Affected (7): 'Architecture beginswith proportion.' (.dz-h1), 'Designed from theinside out.' (.dz-statement), 'A ConsideredArchitecture' (#dz-t-architecture), 'Materials chosento age with dignity.' (#dz-t-materials), 'Quiet interiors,precisely resolved.' (#dz-t-interiors), 'Precision is mostvisible at the edges.' (#dz-t-detail), 'From First Lineto Final Detail' (#dz-t-process). Fix in scripts/design_main.html (add a space before each `
`) and re-run scripts/build_design.py, or replace display:none with a br that renders a space.

Active state (class is-on) never applies to Interiors, Materials and Landscape at 1440x900 and 390x844 (smooth scroll itself works — section lands at top=168 desktop / 139 mobile for all 6). Root cause: `sections.forEach(o => { if (o.sec.offsetTop <= line) active = o.a; })` picks the LAST match in link order, but link order (architecture, interiors, materials, light, landscape, detail) differs from DOM order (architecture, proportion, light, materials, interiors, detail, landscape), so a link whose section is higher up wins. Fix: sort `sections` by `sec.offsetTop` before marking (or iterate in document order).

issues: Captions/eyebrows/index links use rgba(45,43,40,.50-.56) on #F2EEE7 = ~2.9-3.1:1 effective contrast at 10-10.5px (.dz-cap, .dz-eyebrow, .dz-index-list a) — below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for text that small; consider raising alpha to ~.68.

Index nav order (Architecture, Interiors, Materials, Light, Landscape, Detail) does not match the page reading order (Architecture, Proportion, Light, Materials, Interiors, Detail, Landscape) — jumping backwards is disorienting and is also what exposes the active-state bug.

action_items:
Add a space before each `
` in scripts/design_main.html headings (or stop hiding br via display:none) and regenerate design.html with scripts/build_design.py — 7 headings currently show glued words on mobile.
In frontend/js/design.js sort the index `sections` array by offsetTop before mark() so Interiors/Materials/Landscape receive the is-on active state.
Optional: reorder the index list to match page order and raise the alpha of .dz-cap/.dz-eyebrow/.dz-index-list a for AA contrast.
critical_code_review_comments: js/design.js mark(): relying on link order for scroll-spy is fragile — sort by offsetTop (or use ScrollTrigger) so the index stays correct if sections are reordered.
Mobile heading break handling should not depend on `br{display:none}` unless the source markup keeps a whitespace character around the break.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (2 of 9 requested checks failed: mobile heading spacing, index active state)

test_credentials: not required (static public pages); /app/memory/test_credentials.md not needed for this iteration
context_for_next_testing_agent: PASSED and need no re-verification unless code changes: no horizontal overflow at 1920/1600/1440/1280/1024/834/768/430/390/375/360 (scrollWidth == innerWidth everywhere); zero console/page errors on design.html, index.html, about.html, construction.html; all 16 /media/images/design/*.webp return 200 and reach naturalWidth>0 after scrolling (initial 'broken' readings are just loading=lazy, not broken paths); every [data-dz] and [data-dz-fig] img reaches opacity 1 after slow scroll, fast jump to bottom and scroll back to top at 1440 and 390 (0 hidden); automated clip/overlap scan over all headings, paragraphs and captions found 0 clipped and 0 overlapping text at 1440/768/390; hamburger opens .side-menu (class 'open'), menu-link-design and footer-link-design both href=design.html on design/index/about, close button works; design-link-construction -> construction.html, design-cta-projects -> projects.html; mobile index strip is horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth 588 > clientWidth 346) without page overflow; construction.html section 06 reaches C.01..C.06 at 1440x900 and 390x844 with no overflow/errors. RETEST after fixes: mobile heading spacing (check innerText of .dz-h1/.dz-h2/.dz-statement at 360/390 for missing spaces) and index is-on state for all 6 links.
rca_of_the_issue:
Heading bug: the mobile media query removes
elements with display:none, but the generated markup has no whitespace adjacent to `
` (e.g. 'Architecture begins
with proportion.'), so removing the break concatenates the two words. Index bug: mark() assigns `active` while iterating links in DOM-list order and keeps the last link whose section offsetTop is above the scroll line; because the visual/link order differs from section order in the document, sections that appear later in the page (interiors, materials, landscape) are always overridden by an earlier-positioned section whose link comes later in the list (light, detail).
